Outputs head.blend, shape.glb, fan-sweeps.json (resolved levers, per lock length, tip radius, standoff and tip depth, rear face against the envelope, dome rows, cavity window intrusion, skinTopZ, components, nonManifoldEdges), source-snapshot/.

parameters.name: spec:paths.planSweep.extra
parameters.what: extra df (rearward) added to the outer wing locks, rising over u0 .16 to u1 .22; the spec asks .044 to .086 at u .20 to .28 (outer wing swept back in plan). Moves the profile shell; sweep .03 to .08.

parameters.name: spec:paths.profileLean.amount
parameters.what: E band leans back this much over its height (y0 .04 to y1 .16); the spec asks about .015

parameters.name: spec:paths.tuftCeiling.yMin
parameters.what: crown tuft path points never above this row (the C tips must stay at least .01 below the front crown)

parameters.name: spec:paths.kRootShift / kSweepDeg
parameters.what: K crown line roots shift toward the centerline; sweep the K clumps downward in the back view

parameters.name: spec:section.p / spine / rollDeg / twistDeg / widthScale / thickScale
parameters.what: rounded section: superellipse exponent, raised spine on the rear face, per-lock roll and twist, global width and thickness scale

parameters.name: spec:clumps
parameters.what: per-clump edits of the table by name or fnmatch pattern (lengthScale, widthScale, thickScale, path, standoff, ...). The default shortens the three lower neck-side E locks so the back width at .18 stays under R01.6; it moved R01.6 from 1.172 to 1.025

parameters.name: spec:backing.inside / belowEnvelope
parameters.what: rear backing slab: rear face this far behind the deepest lock fronts, at least this far inside the envelope

parameters.name: spec:union.rootBand / rootCap / burial
parameters.what: root band where locks are joined smoothly to the head, how far each solid is carried into the head, extra root burial

parameters.name: spec:dome.blur
parameters.what: dome heightfield blur (voxels) inside the crease, crest held; 0 turns it off

parameters.name: spec:strip.depth / cutSmooth / edge / crown
parameters.what: how deep the old rear coat is cleared, cut smoothing, nape and crown fades

parameters.name: spec:voxel
parameters.what: grid size (figure heights, head-local scaled by the tool). .0018 raised the R05 neck excess to .0034 and cost R01.1 a hair; .002 left R05 at .0020

parameters.name: spec:layers[i].standoff / undercut / rootBlend / lengthScale
parameters.what: layer stack: tip standoff toward the head per layer (E under M, T under I under K under C), undercut of the lower flank, root blend; lists are edited whole through recipe set --spec, not by index sweeps
